_about: Night market switches and cosmetic routines (docs/maps/night_market.md). Ross answered the four layout decisions on 2026-10-09: a LOUD, cheerful market from the start (the passing patrol is the only hush); the repair shop in the old dock office with Otis moving to the Forge; one way after the loader wakes; the colossus visible in phase 1. Each is one line here so flipping it later is a data edit. Others read it: Audio Designer (market_tone, ambience, hush), Gameplay Programmers (town life, VS-43), the junkyard and arena generators (one_way_after_loader, colossus_in_phase_1).

market_tone.decision: Ross 2026-10-09: B, loud and cheerful from the start; the Signals patrol is the only hush. (The older whisper-market option, Quiet Hours muffling the town, is not built.)
market_tone.affects: audio, ambience, ambient bark volume; no geometry

repair_shop.decision: Ross 2026-10-09: A, the repair shop is the old dock-office room (market_repair, off the Wharf), Otis moves to the Forge, hatch from the hideout.
repair_shop.affects: rooms and placements (B would add a room to make_market_rooms.py and rooms.json)

one_way_after_loader.decision: Ross 2026-10-09: A, one way from the loader onward (junkyard map).

colossus_in_phase_1.decision: Ross 2026-10-09: A, the dormant colossus is visible from the first frame of the arena.

flags.job_main_taken: main job taken; Courier Pass given; opens Gate 4's barrier
flags.patrol_hush: set for 15 s while the Signals patrol is within 8 m of an NPC (people duck and go quiet; music ducks)
flags.market_party: set after the boss: the small payoff for a market that is already loud (see ending_payoff)

patrol._about: Cosmetic Signals patrol in Tarp Square, the only hush in a loud market: two wolves walk this loop on the hour at 1.2 m/s (a short pass of about 15 s). Scenery, not enemies (no combat in town). Waypoints are [x, z] in room metres. Until the town-life work (VS-43) they stand at their idle spots (mk_sq_wolf_a / mk_sq_wolf_b). NPCs within hush_radius_m duck, go quiet and the music and radios duck for hush_s seconds (flag patrol_hush). They never block a door.

pending.junk_j1: the junkyard's first room (docs/maps/junkyard.md); Gate 4's barrier door leads to it with spawn from_market

ambience._about: Sound sources for the Audio Designer (market is loud and busy from the start). Positions are room metres [x, z]; rooms are market_* ids. kind: music (a stall or speaker stack), radio (a chatty counter radio), arcade (cabinet beeps), crowd (murmur and shouting), chimes (wind chimes on the poles). Every source ducks while patrol_hush is set. Loops: all of them.
ambience._quiet_rooms: market_gate is the grim edge: only the searchlight hum and the radio from the booth.

ending_payoff._about: The old 'market gets loud after Kasp' payoff is gone (the market is loud from the start). Suggested small replacements for Ross to pick from; staging only, the Writer writes the words.
options: A street party: stalls light up all at once, string lights flash, Pop hands Red a free bowl, the kids race drones on the square
B the propaganda posters and the screen torn down: Kasp's memo board is empty, the Admiral's face gets a sticker moustache for real
C the patrol wolves wave and walk past without the hush: nobody ducks any more
ending_payoff.recommended: B with a dash of A: the screens go dark (the posters come down) and Pop gives her the free bowl; costs a flag swap on the screens and one conversation variant
